name: VendorDeliveryReceiving
tagline: Receive every delivery against the ASN and claim back every short, damaged or warm case – goods-in, claims and supplier scorecards in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete goods-in app for stores, hotels and restaurants: today's dock schedule with booked slots, check-in and overdue deliveries, line-by-line receiving against the ASN with damaged quantities, blind counting and probe temperatures for chilled and frozen, automatic discrepancies with reasons, refusals, credit claims with a claim letter, credit notes and recovery rate, and a supplier scorecard for on-time, fill rate, temperature and claims. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any data source in a few clicks.
features: Today's dock schedule with booked slots, check-in and overdue deliveries
Receive line by line against the ASN – pre-filled or blind count
Probe temperatures for chilled and frozen lines with configurable limits
Refuse a delivery with a reason
Credit claims with a printable claim letter
Credit notes, short credits, overdue claims and recovery rate
Supplier scorecard: on time, fill rate, temperature, claims, grade A–D
Role rules and write-off limits (receiver, supervisor, store manager)
Drill-down, bulk claim / credit / accept, undo, CSV export
Power Fx outputs and events (ClaimText, SummaryJson)
